subject: Pilot credits & pricing qualification - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodInference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Narayanan <priya@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodInference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits & pricing qualification - Acme Health

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned on pricing and the pilot extension:

Summary from call:
- Primary goal: prototype a clinical note summarization feature integrated into Acme’s provider portal.
- Expected pilot timeframe: 30 days (proof of concept).
- Expected traffic: ~5–15M tokens/month (peak days ~1.2M tokens).
- Current target budget for pilot: ~$2k / month (funding from innovation team).
- Target unit economics: looking to land around $100–150 per 1M tokens for generation + light context.

Open items / asks:
1) Can you confirm expected average daily tokens for the 30-day pilot (helps projection)?
2) Are there any compliance checklist items we need to include before we ship data to the private pilot environment?
3) We can offer a time-limited credits extension to cover the pilot — I’ll route for approval if the numbers make sense. If you confirm 30-day expected volume, we’ll size credits and share the official approval doc.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Run a quick burn-rate projection based on the volume you confirm and propose a credit amount (I can approve up to $2k from SDR budget; finance sign-off needed for anything larger).
- Draft a short mutual action plan and share the DocuSign SOW for pilot extension if you’re ready.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min follow-up if that’s easier than email.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: "pilot-guidelines.pdf" (guidelines, 2 pages)

From: Samir Shah <samir@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodInference.com>
Cc: Priya Narayanan <priya@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing qualification - Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below.

Average / expected volume:
- We expect roughly 8–12M tokens over the 30-day pilot (average 0.3–0.4M tokens/day, peaks up to ~1.2M/day on heavy clinic days).
- Most requests are single-turn generation (~150–200 tokens per request) with variable context sizes (5–12k tokens for long notes).

Budget + unit economics:
- Innovation team allocated $2k for the pilot window.
- If unit pricing is ~$100/1M tokens, that would be comfortable (cost estimate: ~900–1,200 USD for 9–12M tokens).
- If pricing is closer to $150/1M, we’d need a small credits top-up to stay within budget.

Compliance:
- We require SOC2 evidence and an IP/data processing addendum (we’ll share the vendor questionnaire later today).

Pilot extension ask:
- If you can provide ~$1,500–$2,000 in pilot credits (or equivalent token allowance) to cover the pilot, we can run the full 30-day window and move quickly to a commercial evaluation.

Happy to join a short sync tomorrow if you want to walk through the burn-rate numbers.

—Samir
Director of Product, Acme Health
samir@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodInference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Narayanan <priya@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodInference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodInference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing qualification - Acme Health

Samir —

Thanks for the details; that helps a lot. Based on your 8–12M projection and target ~$100/1M, I ran a conservative burn-rate projection (attached) — at 10M tokens the estimated cost at $100/1M is $1,000; at 12M it’s $1,200.

Good news: I’ve routed a pilot credits approval for $2,000 to cover the 30-day window (this covers your ask and gives a small buffer if you spike). See attached approval PDF from Finance (pilot-credits-approval.pdf).

What happens next:
- Credits: We will apply the $2,000 account credit to your sandbox project immediately once you confirm the project ID. Credits are valid for 30 days.
- Compliance: Please send over the vendor questionnaire — Rishi (cc’d) will own the SOC2 evidence and will follow up with the compliance artifacts we have available.
- SOW/DocuSign: If you’d like Redwood to sign a short one-page pilot SOW, let me know and I’ll push the DocuSign.

Can you confirm the sandbox project ID and the date you want the pilot to start? I’ll schedule a 15-min kickoff and confirm credits application ASAP.

Thanks — excited to get you running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- pilot-credits-approval.pdf (approval memo, 1 page)
- acme-usage-report-may.csv (burn-rate projection, CSV)
